recognize_zh: 中央大型漿細胞核偏位、細胞質嗜鹼性，整個細胞質布滿細小紅紫色嗜天青顆粒，周圍數顆漿細胞亦有類似顆粒，即Snapper-Schneid顆粒；需與前骨髓細胞區分。
features: Large plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus, coarse chromatin, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous fine to coarse reddish-purple azurophilic granules scattered throughout the cytoplasm (Snapper-Schneid granules)
Neighboring plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and similar granular cytoplasm
No Auer rods; granules do not obscure the nucleus
Background with segmented neutrophil, small lymphocyte, and red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clock-face to coarse chromatin, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm. Several cells, including a large central plasma cell, contain numerous reddish-purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules (Snapper-Schneid granules). Neutrophils, lymphocytes, and red cells are present in the background. Findings represent azurophilic granulation in plasma cells, which is described in plasma cell neoplasms; quantitation and clonality assessment are needed for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes have a paler perinuclear Golgi zone, finer chromatin with nucleoli, and MPO-positive primary granules, whereas granulated plasma cells retain clock-face chromatin and CD138 positivity.
Mast cells have round central nuclei with dense purple-black metachromatic granules that often obscure the nucleus and are tryptase/CD117 positive.
Crystal-storing plasma cells show needle- or rod-shaped crystals rather than round azurophilic granules.
